body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> JC Hyun Systems(www.myrunz.com) presented its in-dash car navigation device ‘RunZ CI-7100’ during CES 2008.
As a built-in navigation system, the CI-7100 adopted 17.7cm(7-inch) widescreen LCD and supports tilt function for users to watch DMB or DVD more conveniently.
Equipped with MMSPII+ CPU for enhanced video playback, it supports CMSS-3D and 24-bit Crystalizer function of ‘X-Fi Audio Processor’ offered by co-working with Creative in Singapore.
Additional features include iPod control, USB host 2.0, Bluetooth, rear camera, karaoke and game.
“Through this exhibition, we will promote the performance and quality of our products and position ourself as a leader of car infortainment market,” the company said.
